title: Two items editing the same file both get a worker
description: Drive the loop against a real control plane: two released items planning the same file are both dispatched in one cycle and master status shows a worker on each at once. Only an explicit exclusive resource held by another item refuses dispatch, with one loop log line naming the item, the resource and the holder; a path the base lacks never blocks.

steps.name: Run the loop's dispatch over items planning the same file and read master status
